systems.type_rule: Labels are OTR's. Residential: labels starting 'Residential' (except garages and transient uses) and condominium units whose OTR description says single-family use. Mixed: 'Residential-Mixed Use'. Vacant: labels starting 'Vacant'. Codes 000 'Not assigned yet' and 995 'Condo Main' (a condominium's master record) are unknown. Everything else, including garages (no living quarters), parking units, hotels, dormitories, commercial and institutional codes, is non-residential. Form (residential and mixed only): condominium labels are a unit; cooperative, apartment, multi-family and 5-unit conversion labels are a multi-family building; 'Less than 5' flats and conversions are small multi-unit (2-4); the rest single-family.

verification.method: Read from OTR's USECODE table by scripts/build_zoning_standards.py

source.name: Metro Nashville Parcels (Parcels_view), LUDesc: General Land Use assigned by the Assessor of Property (Parcels metadata document)

systems.type_rule: Labels are the Assessor's; the type is read from the label. Residential: SINGLE FAMILY, DUPLEX, TRIPLEX, QUADPLEX, RESIDENTIAL CONDO, ZERO LOT LINE, MOBILE HOME, RESIDENTIAL COMBO/MISC and the APARTMENT labels. Vacant: labels containing VACANT. Unknown (a home may or may not be there): RURAL COMBO, PARSONAGE, DORMITORY/BOARDING HOUSE. All others non-residential. Form: SINGLE FAMILY, ZERO LOT LINE and MOBILE HOME single-family; DUPLEX, TRIPLEX, QUADPLEX small multi-unit (2-4); RESIDENTIAL CONDO a unit; APARTMENT labels a multi-family building; RESIDENTIAL COMBO/MISC not stated.

verification.method: Field definition read from the metadata PDF; the distinct LUCode/LUDesc pairs read from the layer by scripts/build_zoning_standards.py

source.name: SanGIS Parcels, NUCLEUS_USE_CD (San Diego County Assessor use code; list printed in the field definition of the layer's metadata)
source.caveat: The metadata says the field is irregularly maintained by the Assessor's Office and land use and zoning fields should only be used as an approximate guide.

systems.type_rule: Labels and group headings are the Assessor's; the type is read from the group. RESIDENTIAL: a single-family house. MULTIPLE: 120 duplex and 130 2-4 units are small multi-unit, the rest a multi-family building. CONDOMINIUMS: a unit, except 174 (operated as a large apartment) a multi-family building. CO-OP/MISC: 180 and 182 co-op units; 190-193 slivers, common areas and access parcels non-residential. MANUFACTURED HOME: 099 (on private property, not a park) single-family; 098 accessories only non-residential; the rest a unit in a park or development. INFO and 000 UNKNOWN: unknown. Labels containing VACANT: vacant. 217 combination commercial/residential: mixed. Everything else non-residential.

verification.method: Code list parsed from the NUCLEUS_USE_CD field definition in the SanGIS Parcels layer metadata by scripts/build_zoning_standards.py
